0022600192.text: The Wizards (4-4) come in 10th in the season, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East after a loss in their most recent game, and they are 2-2 on the road. The Thunder (6-2) sit 4th in the West on a two-game winning streak and are 4-0 at home. Washington is without Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost both games in the 2025-26 season, most recently 132-111 in Washington on March 21, 2026.
